english_course_availability.notes: IB and WI International Programme in English; students may combine modules across faculties on request.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 English required for Bachelor exchange courses (Master requirements vary); consult HHN application page regarding TOEFL/IELTS vs home-partner certification.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=3

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught international programmes; German C1 needed only for regular German-taught modules.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: Winter Semester runs September-February (exact WS2024-25 orientation/exam dates per annual academic calendar).

tuition_model.notes: Partner exchange students are exempt from EUR 1,500/semester non-EU Baden-Württemberg tuition fees and pay only the semester contribution.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4
est_monthly_living_local.notes: WS2024-25 fact sheet p.4 cites approx. EUR 934/month covering rent, food, health insurance, and broadcasting fee (official incoming site updates German visa financial benchmark to EUR 992/month).

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate from EUR 934/month converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (collected 2026-11-15, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); math: 934 * 5 * 1.1052 = 5,161.28 USD (approx. USD 5,161).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory student contribution fee EUR 94/semester for partner exchange students in WS2024-25 (regular fee EUR 188/semester per HHN site) plus mandatory health insurance (~EUR 120/month unless EU EHIC exempt).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4
housing_availability.notes: Students can apply for dormitories via exchange application, but demand exceeds supply; student tutors assist with private housing search.

housing_notes.value: Dormitories ~EUR 350/month (supply < demand); assisted private rooms EUR 350-600/month.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Deutschlandstipendium applies to regular enrolled students; no HHN-funded grant documented for short-term incoming non-EU exchange students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students should apply for a German student visa 5-6 months prior (fact sheet p.4); HHN incoming web page specifies EUR 992/month financial proof (blocked account/scholarship).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Heilbronn University of Applied Sciences/Information Sheet HHN WS2024-25 for Incomings.pdf#page=4
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Lead time 5-6 months from WS2024-25 fact sheet p.4; EUR 992/month statutory threshold updated on hs-heilbronn.de/en/incoming-general-information.

exchange_page_url.notes: Application portal link https://www.hs-heilbronn.de/en/application-for-incomings also in fact sheet p.3.

credit_system_and_load.notes: Uses ECTS; normal semester credit load for incoming exchange students not explicitly stated in WS2024-25 fact sheet.

campus_type.notes: Four campuses: Bildungscampus Heilbronn (IB, WI), Heilbronn-Sontheim (TE, IT), Schwäbisch Hall (MV), and Künzelsau (TW).

international_support_services.value: Introductory days, intensive German courses (pre-semester and semester), and student tutor assistance for private housing.

nomination_deadlines.value: Winter Semester (Fall): nomination May 1, application May 15; Summer Semester (Spring): nomination Nov 15, application Dec 1.
